snippet: I packaged up the 'autoresearch' project into a new self-contained minimal repo. Basically nanochat LLM training core stripped down to single-GPU, one file ~630 lines of code. Human iterates on prompt, AI agent iterates on training code.

The next step for autoresearch is that it has to be asynchronously massively collaborative for agents (think: SETI@home style). The goal is not to emulate a single PhD student, it's to emulate a research community of them.

Three days ago I left autoresearch tuning nanochat for ~2 days on depth=12 model. It found ~20 changes that improved the validation loss. All were additive and transferred to larger depth=24 models. 11% speedup stacking all changes.
My autoresearch labs got wiped out in the oauth outage. Have to think through failovers. Intelligence brownouts will be interesting - the planet losing IQ points when frontier AI stutters.
Why everyone is talking about Andrej Karpathy's autonomous AI research agent. Fortune coverage of autoresearch and its implications for AI-driven scientific discovery.
Andrej Karpathy's new open source 'autoresearch' lets you run hundreds of AI experiments a night - with revolutionary implications. VentureBeat coverage.

Statement from Dario Amodei on our discussions with the Department of War. Amodei states Anthropic cannot in good conscience allow DoD to use Claude for fully autonomous weapons or mass domestic surveillance.
Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei calls OpenAI's messaging around military deal 'straight up lies'. Amodei referred to OpenAI's DoD dealings as 'safety theater' in a memo to staff.

Dario Amodei says Claude AI models may have gained consciousness and are exhibiting signs of anxiety. Claude Opus 4.6 assigns itself 15-20% probability of being conscious. Interpretability team found activation features associated with panic, anxiety.

Where things stand with the Department of War. Amodei updates on negotiations with Pentagon, states red lines on autonomous weapons and mass surveillance remain firm. Intends to challenge ban in court.

Sam Altman admits AI is killing the labor-capital balance and says nobody knows what to do about it. Comments on economic disruption from AI.
Sam Altman says an AI will be a better CEO of OpenAI than him in the reasonably near future. Companies and countries will face pressure to give AI more influential roles or fall behind.

AlphaGo at 10: How AI Innovation Is Paving the Path to AGI. Hassabis commemorates 10 years since AlphaGo defeated world champion at Go, heralding modern AI era. AlphaGo's Move 37 demonstrated AI potential for real-world scientific problems.

We're making great progress with our Gemini Robotics work in bringing AI to the physical world. Super excited to announce our partnership with @BostonDynamics, combining our SOTA robotics models with their world-class hardware.
AI pioneer Yann LeCun's new startup AMI Labs has raised $1 billion in initial funding. LeCun officially left Meta after 12 years, now executive chairman of Advanced Machine Intelligence Labs.
Fortune Tech: Yann LeCun's billion anti-Meta bet. AMI Labs raised $1.03B at $3.5B valuation to build world models as alternative to LLMs. JEPA architecture, HQ in Paris.

Yann LeCun officially left Meta after spending 12 years at the company. Now executive chairman of AMI Labs. Main disagreement: Meta bet too hard on LLMs while his world model approach kept losing resources.

Yann LeCun says today's AI only looks intelligent. Very good at manipulating language but still cannot understand the physical world, maintain real memory or truly plan. Next generation of AI needs to understand the world, not just talk about it.
Jim Fan congratulates LeCun on launching AMI Labs: '@sainingxie @kchonyc @ylecun @amilabs Congrats on launching!' Reflects AI community response to LeCun's $1B startup.
